name: Clean, Shaven
description: Peter Winter, a man living with schizophrenia, searches for his daughter while struggling with frightening hallucinations, fractured memories, and a murder investigation closing in around him.

name: Fight Club
description: An exhausted office worker and a charismatic soap maker create an underground fight club that grows into a violent revolt against consumer culture and the identities built around it.

name: Pi
description: A paranoid mathematician becomes convinced that a hidden numerical pattern can explain nature, predict the stock market, and reveal something dangerously close to the divine.

name: The Machinist
description: An industrial worker who has not slept for a year begins losing his grip on reality after a workplace accident, cryptic notes, and the appearance of a man nobody else seems to know.

name: Poor Things
description: Bella Baxter, a young woman returned to life by an eccentric scientist, escapes into the world and rapidly develops her own ideas about freedom, desire, knowledge, and social rules.

name: Oldboy
description: After being imprisoned in a private cell for fifteen years without explanation, Oh Dae-su is suddenly released and given five days to discover who destroyed his life and why.

name: Shutter Island
description: A U.S. marshal investigates a patient's disappearance from an isolated psychiatric hospital, but the island's staff, storm-battered grounds, and his own memories steadily undermine his version of reality.

name: The Goldfinch
description: A boy survives a museum bombing that kills his mother and secretly carries away a priceless painting, a choice that follows him through grief, addiction, friendship, and the criminal art world.

name: No Country for Old Men
description: A hunter takes a case of drug money from a desert crime scene and is pursued by an eerily methodical killer while an aging sheriff tries to understand the violence spreading across West Texas.

name: American Psycho
description: A wealthy Wall Street banker hides violent impulses behind a flawless routine of status, fashion, restaurants, and empty conversation as his identity begins to dissolve into performance.

name: Guy Ritchie's The Covenant
description: An American soldier returns to Afghanistan to rescue the interpreter who once carried him to safety and was then abandoned to the people hunting him.

name: Ichi the Killer
description: A sadistic yakuza enforcer searches for his missing boss and collides with Ichi, a deeply manipulated killer whose violence erupts through fragmented memories, humiliation, and rage.

name: Joker
description: Arthur Fleck, an isolated party clown and aspiring comedian, is repeatedly humiliated by Gotham until personal collapse and public anger transform him into a symbol of violent rebellion.

name: Juno
description: A sharp-tongued teenager faces an unexpected pregnancy and chooses an adoptive couple, discovering that adulthood and supposedly perfect relationships are messier than they first appear.

name: Killer Klowns from Outer Space
description: Alien creatures resembling circus clowns invade a small town and harvest its residents with deadly jokes, living balloons, shadow puppets, and cotton-candy cocoons.

name: Ready or Not
description: On her wedding night, a bride is forced into a family tradition that turns a harmless game of hide-and-seek into a bloody hunt through an enormous mansion.

name: Orphan
description: A grieving couple adopts a remarkably composed nine-year-old girl, but her manipulative behavior and concealed history place the entire household in danger.

name: Case 39
description: A social worker rescues a young girl from abusive parents and brings her home, only to realize that the child may be the source of the terror surrounding every case she touches.

name: 21 Jump Street
description: Two immature police officers go undercover as high-school students to expose a drug supplier and discover that modern teenage life has reversed everything they remember.

name: Together
description: A couple moves to the countryside hoping to repair a strained relationship, but contact with an unnatural force begins binding their bodies and identities in horrifying ways.

name: Raw
description: A vegetarian veterinary student undergoes a brutal initiation and develops an overwhelming hunger for flesh, forcing her to confront desire, family secrets, and her changing body.

name: The Substance
description: A fading celebrity uses an underground treatment to create a younger, idealized version of herself, but the two bodies cannot peacefully share one life.

name: I Feel Pretty
description: After a head injury, an insecure woman becomes convinced that she is extraordinarily beautiful, and her new confidence transforms her career, relationships, and treatment of others.

name: Nerve
description: A cautious student joins an online game of increasingly dangerous dares, only to discover that its anonymous audience controls far more than the prize money.

name: Murder Mystery
description: A New York couple on a long-delayed European vacation becomes trapped aboard a billionaire's yacht and blamed for a murder among a group of wealthy suspects.

name: Lucy
description: A woman forced to transport an experimental drug gains rapidly expanding mental and physical abilities, pushing her beyond ordinary human perception while criminals and scientists pursue her.

name: Limitless
description: A struggling writer takes a mysterious drug that gives him extraordinary focus and memory, turning him into a financial prodigy while dependency and dangerous enemies close in.

name: Inception
description: A specialist who steals secrets through shared dreams is offered a chance to return home if his team can plant an idea deep inside a target's layered subconscious.

name: Nanny McPhee
description: A mysterious nanny uses unsettling magic and strict lessons to transform seven uncontrollable children and help their overwhelmed widowed father save the family.

name: Best Player
description: A champion gamer discovers that the anonymous rival threatening his record is a teenage girl and enters her school life to sabotage her before a major tournament.

name: Jinxed
description: A teenager from a family cursed with constant bad luck searches for a way to break the spell before it ruins another generation of Murphy disasters.

name: 10 Lives
description: A selfish cat wastes the lives he has been given and must return in a series of unexpected animal bodies to repair his bond with the scientist who saved him.

name: Begotten
description: In a wordless, decayed monochrome nightmare, divine figures undergo birth, mutilation, death, and rebirth through ritualistic images that resemble a damaged ancient film.

name: Peeping Tom
description: A withdrawn camera operator murders women while filming their final terror, turning cinema, voyeurism, childhood trauma, and the gaze of the audience into one disturbing mechanism.

name: Split
description: Three teenagers are kidnapped by a man whose dissociative identities compete for control while a powerful new personality prepares to emerge.

name: Longlegs
description: An FBI agent with unusual intuition follows occult clues connecting a series of family deaths to an elusive killer and to secrets buried in her own childhood.

name: Scary Movie
description: Cindy, Brenda, Shorty, Ray, and old friends reunite when a familiar masked killer returns, pulling them into another barrage of horror parodies and absurd survival attempts.

name: The Silence of the Lambs
description: An FBI trainee seeks insight from imprisoned psychiatrist and murderer Hannibal Lecter while hunting a serial killer who abducts women and carefully removes their skin.

name: Manhunter
description: A gifted former profiler returns to pursue a killer who targets entire families, using Hannibal Lecktor's mind at the risk of losing himself inside the investigation.

name: Hannibal
description: Years after his escape, Hannibal Lecter lives under a new identity in Florence while Clarice Starling and a horribly disfigured survivor are drawn into his return.

name: Red Dragon
description: Profiler Will Graham reluctantly consults the imprisoned Hannibal Lecter to stop a ritualistic family murderer known as the Tooth Fairy.

name: Hannibal Rising
description: A young Hannibal Lecter survives wartime horror and develops his intelligence, refinement, and appetite while pursuing the men responsible for his sister's death.

name: Saw
description: Two strangers wake chained inside a ruined bathroom and discover that an unseen captor has designed a brutal test of sacrifice, guilt, and the will to live.

name: Saw II
description: Detective Eric Matthews confronts Jigsaw while eight people, including the detective's son, search a poisoned house for antidotes hidden inside lethal traps.

name: Saw III
description: A dying Jigsaw and Amanda force a grieving father through tests of forgiveness while a kidnapped surgeon must keep their mastermind alive.

name: Saw IV
description: As investigators uncover Jigsaw's history, an obsessed SWAT officer is pushed through a sequence of tests designed to punish his need to save everyone.

name: Saw V
description: Agent Strahm closes in on Jigsaw's successor while five strangers face interconnected traps that can only be survived through cooperation.

name: Saw VI
description: Jigsaw's legacy targets a health-insurance executive whose life-and-death formulas are turned into physical tests, while the investigation threatens to expose Hoffman.

name: Saw 3D
description: A man who built fame on a false story of surviving Jigsaw is forced to face real traps as Hoffman and Jill fight over the final pieces of John's legacy.

name: Jigsaw
description: Bodies begin appearing with wounds linked to Jigsaw's methods, forcing police to determine whether John Kramer has returned or a new disciple is reconstructing his games.

name: Spiral: From the Book of Saw
description: A detective investigates elaborate murders of corrupt police officers carried out by a killer using traps and symbols inspired by Jigsaw.

name: Saw X
description: John Kramer travels to Mexico for an experimental cancer treatment and turns his methods against the fraudsters who exploited his desperation.

name: The Conjuring
description: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren help a family whose isolated farmhouse is being consumed by an increasingly violent supernatural presence.

name: Annabelle
description: After a cult attacks a young couple, a vintage doll becomes a vessel for a demonic force that stalks the expectant mother and her newborn child.

name: The Conjuring 2
description: Ed and Lorraine Warren travel to London to help a single mother and her children as a malicious entity turns their public haunting into a deadly test of faith.

name: Annabelle: Creation
description: Years after losing their daughter, a dollmaker and his wife shelter an orphanage group, unknowingly offering a demonic presence new victims.

name: The Nun
description: A priest and a novice investigate a nun's death at a Romanian abbey, where the demonic figure Valak has turned the convent into a gateway for evil.

name: The Curse of La Llorona
description: A social worker and her children become targets of the weeping spirit La Llorona, whose grief drives her to steal other families' children.

name: Annabelle Comes Home
description: Annabelle is awakened inside the Warrens' artifact room and unleashes the collection's other spirits against their daughter and her babysitters.

name: The Conjuring: The Devil Made Me Do It
description: The Warrens investigate a murder suspect who claims demonic possession, uncovering an occult chain of curses that reaches beyond a single haunted home.

name: The Nun II
description: Sister Irene encounters Valak again at a French boarding school, where a string of deaths reveals the demon's search for a sacred relic.

name: The Conjuring: Last Rites
description: Ed and Lorraine Warren confront a final major case when a Pennsylvania family is terrorized by escalating activity connected to the Smurl haunting.

name: A Nightmare on Elm Street
description: Teenagers discover that the burned killer stalking their dreams can murder them in reality, forcing Nancy Thompson to fight him without falling asleep.

name: A Nightmare on Elm Street 2: Freddy's Revenge
description: A teenager moves into Nancy's former home and becomes the unwilling vessel Freddy Krueger needs to enter the waking world.

name: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
description: Nancy helps psychiatric patients recognize their powers inside dreams and unite against Freddy before he claims the last Elm Street children.

name: A Nightmare on Elm Street 4: The Dream Master
description: Freddy returns through the dreams of the surviving warriors and encounters Alice, whose growing dream powers may finally rival his own.

name: A Nightmare on Elm Street 5: The Dream Child
description: Freddy invades the dreams of Alice's unborn child and uses them to reach new victims while she uncovers the history of his birth.

name: Freddy's Dead: The Final Nightmare
description: With Springwood's children gone, Freddy sends the last surviving teenager to bring him new victims and expose the family history behind the killer.

name: Wes Craven's New Nightmare
description: The actors and creators of the original film are haunted in the real world by an ancient entity that has adopted Freddy Krueger's form.

name: Freddy vs. Jason
description: Freddy manipulates Jason Voorhees into spreading fear on Elm Street, but the two killers turn on each other when Jason steals Freddy's victims.

name: A Nightmare on Elm Street
description: A group of teenagers shares nightmares about a burned man with bladed gloves and uncovers the childhood connection that made them his targets.

name: The Ship
description: Students and crew aboard a training vessel survive a global catastrophe and search for land while secrets, conflict, and unexplained events spread through the isolated ship.

name: Survival Game
description: Sixteen people enter a remote Siberian reality show with no communication or crew, only to discover that the staged competition has become a genuine fight for survival.

name: Squid Game
description: Hundreds of desperate contestants accept an invitation to play children's games for an enormous prize, learning that elimination means death and cooperation can collapse at any moment.

name: Riverdale
description: A group of teenagers investigates murder and corruption beneath the polished surface of Riverdale as the town's mysteries grow increasingly strange and dangerous.

name: Stranger Things
description: The disappearance of a boy in 1980s Indiana brings his friends into contact with a secret laboratory, a psychic girl, and a hostile dimension pressing against their town.

name: Mr. Robot
description: A brilliant but unstable cybersecurity engineer is recruited by an underground hacker group to erase global debt and attack the corporation dominating modern life.

name: Black Mirror
description: An anthology of unsettling stories explores how familiar technologies magnify obsession, cruelty, surveillance, loneliness, and the need for social approval.

name: Hannibal
description: Profiler Will Graham relies on psychiatrist Hannibal Lecter while investigating serial killers, unaware that his elegant therapist is shaping both the crimes and Will's collapsing mind.

name: Junji Ito Collection
description: An anthology adapts Junji Ito's grotesque stories about obsession, impossible bodies, curses, doubles, fashion models, and ordinary lives invaded by inexplicable horror.

name: Attack on Titan
description: Humanity hides behind enormous walls until man-eating Titans destroy the illusion of safety and a group of young soldiers uncovers the political history behind their world.

name: The Promised Neverland
description: Gifted children living in an idyllic orphanage learn the horrifying purpose of their home and secretly plan an escape from the adults controlling them.

name: Sword Art Online
description: Players trapped inside a virtual-reality fantasy game must clear one hundred floors to escape, knowing that death in the game will also kill their real bodies.

name: My Dress-Up Darling
description: A quiet student skilled at making traditional dolls begins creating cosplay outfits for an energetic classmate, drawing both of them into a close creative friendship.

name: The Pet Girl of Sakurasou
description: A student living in a dorm for school misfits becomes responsible for a brilliant artist who can barely manage everyday life, while everyone around them chases difficult creative ambitions.

name: Beastars
description: At a school shared by carnivores and herbivores, a gentle wolf struggles with instinct, shame, and love after a student's murder exposes the fragile rules holding society together.

name: Tokyo Ghoul
description: A student becomes half-ghoul after a violent encounter and must survive between human society and the hidden community that feeds on it.

name: Death Note
description: A brilliant student gains a notebook that kills anyone whose name is written inside and begins remaking the world while an equally gifted detective hunts him.

name: Bakugan Battle Brawlers
description: Children discover that the creatures inside their strategy game are real beings from another dimension and become responsible for protecting both worlds.

name: Shaman King
description: A relaxed young shaman joins a global tournament in which mediums fight alongside spirits for the right to become Shaman King and reshape the world.

name: Avatar: The Last Airbender
description: A young Air Nomad awakens after a century and must master four elements with his friends to end the Fire Nation's war and restore balance.

name: The Garden of Words
description: A student who dreams of designing shoes repeatedly meets an older woman in a rainy garden, where their quiet conversations become shelter from lives neither can face directly.

name: Danganronpa: The Animation
description: Elite students are imprisoned inside their academy by a sadistic bear and told that graduation requires murdering a classmate without being exposed at trial.

name: Hello World
description: A shy teenager is visited by his future self, who asks him to change recorded reality and save the girl they both love from an approaching disaster.

name: Magical Girl Site
description: A brutally bullied girl receives a weapon from a sinister website and enters a hidden network of magical girls watched by grotesque administrators preparing for an apocalypse.

name: Maquia: When the Promised Flower Blooms
description: An immortal girl adopts an orphaned human baby and experiences the beauty and pain of motherhood as he grows old while she remains unchanged.

name: Malice@Doll
description: In a city abandoned by humanity, an android built to serve people is transformed into living flesh and tries to share her new condition with other purposeless machines.

name: Uzumaki
description: The residents of Kurouzu become obsessed with spirals as the pattern infects their minds, bodies, weather, buildings, and the structure of the town itself.

name: Parasyte: The Maxim
description: A failed alien parasite takes control of a teenager's right hand, forcing the mismatched pair to cooperate against creatures that successfully replaced human brains.

name: One Piece
description: Monkey D. Luffy gathers a wildly different pirate crew and crosses a vast ocean of islands, governments, mysteries, and rival powers in search of the legendary One Piece.

name: Hunter x Hunter
description: Gon leaves home to become a licensed Hunter and find his father, entering exams and adventures that grow from playful challenges into morally complex battles.

name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
description: After demons slaughter his family and transform his sister, Tanjiro joins the Demon Slayer Corps to find a cure and confront the origin of their suffering.

name: Jujutsu Kaisen
description: A physically gifted student swallows a cursed object and enters a school of sorcerers, sharing his body with an ancient monster while learning to fight human fear made real.

name: Chainsaw Man
description: An impoverished devil hunter merges with his chainsaw-shaped companion and is recruited into a government unit where simple dreams collide with manipulation and extreme violence.

name: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
description: Two brothers damaged by forbidden alchemy search for the Philosopher's Stone and uncover a nationwide conspiracy built on war, sacrifice, and manufactured immortality.

name: Steins;Gate
description: A group of eccentric friends accidentally learns to send messages into the past, attracting a powerful organization and creating timelines filled with increasingly personal consequences.

name: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion
description: An exiled prince gains the power to issue an irresistible command and becomes a masked revolutionary determined to destroy the empire that abandoned his family.

name: Monster
description: A surgeon saves a child's life instead of obeying hospital politics and years later learns that the boy became a terrifying manipulator at the center of a trail of murders.

name: Berserk
description: A solitary mercenary joins the ambitious Griffith and his Band of the Hawk, forming bonds that are ultimately consumed by power, fate, and supernatural betrayal.

name: Made in Abyss
description: A young explorer and a robot boy descend into an enormous pit filled with beautiful ecosystems, ancient relics, monstrous life, and a curse that punishes anyone who climbs back up.

name: Mob Psycho 100
description: An awkward boy with overwhelming psychic power tries to build an ordinary identity under the guidance of a fraudulent mentor while his suppressed emotions approach a breaking point.

name: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
description: After losing everything in Night City, a teenager joins a crew of mercenaries and pushes his body through dangerous cybernetic upgrades in pursuit of freedom and belonging.

name: Death Parade
description: Newly dead strangers are forced to play cruel games in a mysterious bar, where an emotionless arbiter judges the hidden choices that defined their lives.

name: Another
description: A transfer student notices that his class behaves as if one girl does not exist and becomes entangled in a curse that produces a chain of elaborate accidental deaths.

name: Erased
description: A struggling man is sent eighteen years into his own childhood and attempts to prevent a classmate's murder, believing it is connected to tragedy in the present.

name: Devilman Crybaby
description: A sensitive teenager gains a demon's body while retaining his human heart, then watches fear and paranoia tear civilization apart as demons reveal themselves.

name: Perfect Blue
description: A pop idol leaves music for acting and loses her sense of reality as a stalker, an online diary, violent productions, and an idealized double begin replacing her identity.

name: Paprika
description: A device that lets therapists enter dreams is stolen, causing private fantasies to merge into a spectacular parade that overwhelms the waking world.

name: Serial Experiments Lain
description: A withdrawn girl receives messages from a dead classmate and becomes absorbed into the Wired, where identity, memory, consciousness, and reality no longer have clear boundaries.

name: Paranoia Agent
description: A mysterious boy attacks stressed residents of Tokyo with a bent baseball bat, and the investigation reveals how rumor and collective fear can create their own reality.

name: Neon Genesis Evangelion
description: A lonely teenager is ordered to pilot a giant biomechanical weapon against mysterious beings while the adults around him hide the true purpose of the battles.

name: Naruto
description: An outcast ninja carrying a sealed monster dreams of earning his village's respect and grows through missions, rivalry, friendship, and the cost of inherited hatred.

name: Naruto: Shippuden
description: Naruto returns from training to confront the Akatsuki, rescue his friend Sasuke, and challenge a cycle of war that reaches back through generations of ninja history.

name: Bleach
description: A teenager who can see ghosts inherits the powers of a Soul Reaper and becomes responsible for guiding spirits and fighting creatures that consume them.

name: My Hero Academia
description: A powerless boy in a society of superhuman abilities inherits the strength of the world's greatest hero and enters an academy shaped by celebrity, duty, and rising villainy.

name: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
description: Generations of the Joestar family face supernatural enemies through flamboyant battles, evolving powers, strange journeys, and a feud that repeatedly reshapes their bloodline.

name: Vinland Saga
description: A boy raised among Viking mercenaries dedicates his life to revenge before war and slavery force him to reconsider strength, freedom, and the possibility of living without enemies.

name: Cowboy Bebop
description: A crew of bounty hunters drifts through the solar system taking disastrous jobs while each member remains trapped by unfinished business from the past.

name: Psycho-Pass
description: In a society that measures every citizen's likelihood of committing crime, a young inspector questions the system while pursuing a killer it cannot recognize as dangerous.

name: Elfen Lied
description: A mutated girl with invisible lethal arms escapes a research facility and develops an innocent alternate personality after a head injury, bringing violence into a quiet household.

name: Higurashi: When They Cry
description: A boy moves to a friendly rural village where the same summer festival repeatedly leads to paranoia, torture, murder, and altered versions of reality.

name: The Future Diary
description: Twelve people receive diaries that predict the future and are forced into a death game, while a lonely boy depends on a girl whose devotion is both protective and terrifying.

name: Tokyo Revengers
description: A dissatisfied adult repeatedly returns to his school years and infiltrates a violent youth gang to prevent the future deaths of the people he failed to protect.

name: Solo Leveling
description: The weakest hunter in a world of monster-filled gates survives a hidden dungeon and gains the unique ability to level up without limit.

name: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
description: An elf mage retraces the journey she once completed with a heroic party and slowly understands the brief human lives and relationships she failed to value at the time.
